QuestInfo.name: Mason the Collector
QuestInfo.0: Mason the Collector would like to ask you for a favor.
QuestInfo.1: Mason the Collector is hard at work, collecting things. He especially likes anything shiny, and he saw an Aurora Marble on the Warped Path of Time. It's gone now, so did someone pick it up?
QuestInfo.2: Just like Mason the collecting fanatic wanted, I managed to gather up more Lazy Buffy marbles and Aurora marbles. In return, I received an item from him that looks quite useful...

0.0: A marble that shines with mystical light... I saw it, for sure. That mystical Aurora-colored marble! I want! I want to collect. Bring me, that marble...

yes.0: I'm so mad. So mad. I was getting so close to that marble, and somebody snatched it away. I want it! Get it from the Lazy Buffy!
yes.1: Get me the marble, any way possible. Add my knowledge to that marble, and I get more Aurora Marbles later on.

no.0: Bring the Aurora Marble to me and I give to you one of my collections. Bring me that shiny marble!

1.0: I might just get swept into that mystical light. You got it? Give it to me now.

yes.0: This is right. Yes, yes. This beautiful color. It's worthy of collection. I will give you nice trade.

item.0: No, you don't have the marble I want! I need 50 Lazy Buffy Marbles and 10 Aurora Marbles! Get right!
